plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-018 Saved eRFX Draft Save Action

steps.note: Open the Events list to locate the existing saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition configuration before navigating.
Apply the required stage-creation configuration before the test.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully before selecting Drafts.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Open the first saved draft, which reopens its create screen.
Click Save as draft and record whether anything opens or visibly changes; the exploration report captures the expected no-visible-change outcome.
Confirm the resulting screen has no error, crash, or malformed content after the click.
